What we fix

Heating, cooling and plumbing, one call.

  • AC repair & installation

    Warm air, short cycling, iced lines, noisy outdoor unit. We find the cause and fix it, or quote a new system if repair no longer makes sense.

    Details

  • Heating & furnaces

    Gas furnaces and heat pumps: no-heat calls, ignition problems, strange smells and yearly safety checks.

    Details

  • Plumbing repair

    Leaks, running toilets, low pressure, faucets, disposals and slab-leak detection, done by a licensed plumber.

    Details

  • Water heaters

    Tank and tankless repair and replacement, same-day when the unit is in stock.

    Details

  • Drain & sewer

    Slow drains, backups and main-line clogs, cleared with the right tool and checked with a camera when needed.

    Details

  • Comfort Club maintenance

    Two tune-ups a year (AC in spring, heat in fall), priority scheduling and a yearly plumbing check.

    Details

How it works

No surprises on the invoice.

  1. 1

    Call or text

    Tell us what's going on. We book a 2-hour arrival window and text you when the tech is on the way.

    The tech finds the cause and gives you written options with prices. Nothing starts until you approve.

Questions

Before you call

Do you charge to come out?

There is a diagnostic fee for repair visits, and it is credited toward the repair if you go ahead. Estimates for a new system or water heater are free. (Sample terms for this demo.)

Do you offer emergency service at night and on weekends?

Yes. Call any time and a dispatcher answers. After-hours rates apply and are explained on the phone before we send a tech.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. We hold a Texas ACR contractor license and a Texas master plumber license, and we carry general liability and workers' comp insurance. License numbers are listed on our About page.
